; layerIndicator.qmd - xochitl 3.28 (written against 3.28.0.172 sources)
;
; Shows the number of the active layer in the top corner of the Layers toolbar button.
; 1 is the bottom (default) layer, 2 the layer above it, and so on (max 5).
; The badge is shown only when the page has more than one layer, and only for the button
; on the toolbar itself, not for the entry in the overflow menu.
;
; toolbar.layersModel is the current page's layer list. Its roles include layerIndex (0 = bottom)
; and layerSelected. It is the same model the Layers foldout uses.

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/LayersMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ToolbarTool#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property int activeLayerNumber: 1
            // Only on the toolbar itself. In the overflow menu the tool is a FoldoutButton list row.
            readonly property bool showLayerBadge: root.type === ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                && !!root.model && root.model.count > 1

            content: Item {
                id: layerIndicator
                anchors.fill: parent

                // Invisible watchers: record which layer is selected. Handlers cover selection
                // changes, reordering, and model resets (page change, add or delete a layer).
                Repeater {
                    model: root.model
                    Item {
                        required property int layerIndex
                        required property bool layerSelected
                        visible: false
                        function report() {
                            if (layerSelected) {
                                root.activeLayerNumber = layerIndex + 1;
                            }
                        }
                        onLayerSelectedChanged: report()
                        onLayerIndexChanged: report()
                        Component.onCompleted: report()
                    }
                }

                // Badge: same spot as the pen color dot on the pen buttons.
                Rectangle {
                    id: layerBadge
                    readonly property int margin: 8
                    readonly property bool highlighted: root.selected || root.implicitlySelected
                    visible: root.showLayerBadge
                    width: 30
                    height: 30
                    radius: width / 2
                    color: highlighted ? "white" : "black"
                    antialiasing: root.antialiasing

                    anchors {
                        top: parent.top
                        topMargin: root.topInset + margin
                    }

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: root.activeLayerNumber
                        color: layerBadge.highlighted ? "black" : "white"
                        font.pixelSize: 20
                        font.bold: true
                    }

                    states: [
                        State {
                            name: "leftPosition"
                            when: root.toolbar.position === ToolbarPositioner.Position.Right
                            AnchorChanges {
                                target: layerBadge
                                anchors.left: parent.left
                                anchors.right: undefined
                            }
                            PropertyChanges {
                                target: layerBadge
                                anchors.leftMargin: margin
                                anchors.rightMargin: 0
                            }
                        },
                        State {
                            name: "rightPosition"
                            when: (true)
                            AnchorChanges {
                                target: layerBadge
                                anchors.right: parent.right
                                anchors.left: undefined
                            }
                            PropertyChanges {
                                target: layerBadge
                                anchors.leftMargin: 0
                                anchors.rightMargin: margin
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
